witness.note: Leges Henrici primi: Liebermann’s edited Latin text, from the manuscripts he names in Gesetze I, p. 547, note a, listed below
London, The National Archives (formerly the Public Record Office), E 164/2 (the Red Book of the Exchequer)
The original of the London collection, Leges Anglorum Londoniis collectae (c. 1210), which survives in copies
London, British Library, Cotton MS Claudius A.iii (K1); but for the Quadripartitus and the London texts Liebermann’s K means Cotton MS Claudius D.ii (K2)
John Selden’s manuscript, now lost (known from Twysden’s variants)
Roger Twysden, in Wheloc’s edition of Lambarde’s Archaionomia (Cambridge, 1644)
London, Guildhall (Corporation of London), a lost manuscript (there from at least 1639 to 1721), known only from the variants cited by earlier editors as “Lond”
Manchester, John Rylands Library, MS Latin 155

div.head: Hn 70.20
div.ab: Si quis sine liberis decesserit, pater aut mater eius in hereditatem succedant, uel frater aut soror, si pater et mater desint.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 589 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)

note.seg: Ebd. Erbgang 23. a; Aszendentenfolge ist nicht im Normann. Rechte und noch bei Glanvilla nicht kraft festen Grundsatzes ausgeschlossen; Brunner Agnorm. Erbfolge 22; in den Nachlass Kinderloser sukzedieren Aszendenten unter Ausschluss der ihnen erst nachstehenden Geschwister im Schwed. Rechte; Fritz Gesetzl. Verwandt. in Sav. Zs. RG., Germ. 36, 149

Ibid. Erbgang 23. a; succession by ascendants is not excluded by any fixed principle in Norman law, nor yet in Glanvilla; Brunner Agnorm. Erbfolge 22; in Swedish law ascendants succeed to the estate of the childless, to the exclusion of the brothers and sisters, who rank only after them; Fritz Gesetzl. Verwandt. in Sav. Zs. RG., Germ. 36, 149

div.ab: If anyone dies without children, let his father or mother succeed to the inheritance, or his brother or sister, if father and mother are lacking.
